key_insight: SOO-UCCD extends sequential minimal optimization to orbital rotations in VQE, enabling gradient-free orbital optimization from a nine-point energy profile.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical way to improve active-space quality and recover UCCSD-level accuracy with shallow quantum circuits while avoiding costly gradient and Hessian evaluations.
method: Optimizes orbital rotation angles sequentially using frequency structure from orbital-rotation generators.
Evaluates each angle with a nine-point classical energy profile built from transformed integrals and measured reduced density matrices.
Eliminates orbital-gradient and Hessian calculations, making the procedure gradient-free and hyperparameter-free.
evidence_signal: State-vector simulations on LiH/STO-3G show bond-stretching curves matching UCCSD-level accuracy and macro-iteration convergence comparable to L-BFGS-based orbital optimization.
watch_item: The approach still requires repeated classical integral transformations and energy-profile evaluations, which may affect scaling in larger systems.
paper_title: Sequential optimization for orbital-optimized variational quantum eigensolvers
